details: Bitcoin experienced significant volatility, initially surging above $78,000 after reports of Iran reopening the Strait of Hormuz, which lifted market sentiment and caused oil prices to plunge. However, the price subsequently fell back to around $76,000, triggering $762 million in liquidations as later reports indicated a re-militarization of the Strait and reimposed shipping restrictions.
title: Bitcoin Price Volatility Amid Shifting Geopolitical Landscape

details: Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) saw robust institutional interest, logging $996 million in net inflows last week, including a substantial $663.9 million on Friday alone. Total assets held in these spot ETFs have now surpassed $101 billion, indicating continued strong institutional adoption.
title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Record Significant Inflows

details: A prominent analyst, Michaël van de Poppe, suggests that altcoins are currently in the "end stage" of their bear market, with many tokens having fallen over 90% from their peaks. He anticipates a significant bullish reversal for altcoins in the near future, following Bitcoin's probable market bottom.
title: Altcoins Poised for Reversal, Analyst Turns Bullish

details: Bitcoin's mining difficulty experienced a 1.1% decrease in the last 24 hours, though it is projected to rise again in the next adjustment period. Additionally, public Bitcoin mining companies sold over 32,000 BTC in the first quarter of 2026, exceeding their total sales for all of 2025, which could exert selling pressure on the market.
title: Bitcoin Mining Difficulty Decreases Amid Record Miner Sales

details: Coinbase has received conditional approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) for a federal national trust charter. This significant regulatory nod will allow Coinbase to expand its institutional custody offerings, managing a vast empire of $376 billion in assets and bolstering confidence in regulated crypto services.
title: Coinbase Secures OCC Approval for Institutional Custody

details: The Ethereum network has achieved an all-time high in quarterly network activity, signaling robust engagement and utilization of the blockchain. This surge in activity underscores the growing demand and development within the Ethereum ecosystem.
title: Ethereum Network Activity Reaches All-Time High
